```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r}
library(taiga)
```

Taiga is the design system of six applications, in two frameworks: **Lumen** (cinematic,
high-contrast, glass-driven) and **Neue** (minimalist, high-density enterprise).

## Choose a framework

```{r}
taiga_frameworks()[, c("framework", "voice", "apps")]
taiga_choose_framework(reader = "analysts", session = "self-directed", density = "high")
```

The full guides are installed with the package:

```{r}
taiga_guides()[, c("topic", "title")]
```

`taiga_guide("lumen-styleguide")` opens one of them.

## Tokens

Each framework has a token sheet of CSS custom properties, with several themes:

```{r}
taiga_themes()[, c("framework", "theme")]
tk <- taiga_tokens("lumen", "dark")
tk[c("--lm-bg", "--lm-text", "--lm-accent", "--lm-ease")]
```

Attach a sheet to a Shiny UI or a document with `taiga_dependency("lumen")`, or start a bslib app
from it with `taiga_bs_theme("lumen", "studio")`.

## Contrast

The styleguides' contrast rules come from an audit you can run on any theme:

```{r}
a <- taiga_contrast_audit("neue", "light")
a[a$fg %in% c("--tn-ink-3", "--tn-ink-4"), c("fg", "bg", "ratio", "wcag")]
taiga_contrast("#ffffff", "#0e8f83")
```

## One front end, three formats

Every Taiga project ships its front end as a Shiny app, a Quarto document and a standalone HTML
file (`taiga_guide("delivery")`). The package includes a tiny example front end:

```{r}
ex <- taiga_example()
taiga_check_assets(c(ex$css, ex$js))$ok
data <- list(title = "Hello, Taiga", items = c("Shiny", "Quarto", "HTML"))
```

Standalone HTML:

```{r}
html <- taiga_export_html(
  taiga_fragment("hello", css = ex$css, js = ex$js, data = data, framework = "lumen"),
  file.path(tempdir(), "hello.html"), title = "Hello"
)
basename(html)
```

Quarto (render the result with `quarto render`):

```{r}
qmd <- taiga_export_quarto(
  taiga_fragment("hello", mode = "quarto", css = ex$css, js = ex$js, data = data, framework = "lumen"),
  tempfile("hello-quarto-"), title = "Hello", before = "The same front end, inside a document."
)
cat(readLines(qmd, n = 10), sep = "\n")
```

Shiny:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
app <- taiga_shiny_app(
  taiga_fragment("hello", mode = "shiny", css = ex$css, js = ex$js, data = data, framework = "lumen"),
  server = function(input, output, session) observeEvent(input$hello_msg, message("from the browser")),
  title = "Hello"
)
shiny::runApp(app)
```

What each format can do:

```{r}
taiga_capabilities()
```

## The applications

```{r}
taiga_apps()[, c("app", "framework", "dialect", "shiny", "quarto", "html")]
x <- taiga_extracted("QuantSkill")
x$n_custom_properties
head(x$easings, 3)
```
